crossRefs.note: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.
All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.
A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.
For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by…

translations.web: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,
translations.bsb: They have become filled with every kind of wickedness, evil, greed, and depravity. They are full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, and malice. They are gossips,
translations.kjv: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
translations.asv: being filled with all unrighteousness, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
